levels.surface: عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك

notes: «حدثنا يحيى» is written bare; the reading does not complete it from the lexicon
«أن عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك، قال سمعت كعب بن مالك» makes both men links: the reporter and the Companion who heard the story
the Prophet's Qur'anic citation is the matn, not a link
